Journal Entry

The Journal Entry view displays detailed information about a journal entry transaction, including its date, reference number, narration, and individual debit and credit line items.

Journal entries are the fundamental building blocks of your accounting system, recording financial transactions by debiting and crediting appropriate accounts according to double-entry bookkeeping principles.

Reviewing Your Journal Entry

From this view, you can review the complete transaction details to ensure accuracy. The system automatically verifies that your debits and credits are balanced.

If your debits and credits don't match, an Unbalanced warning will appear at the bottom of the entry. This indicates that the entry needs to be corrected before it can properly affect your accounts.

Making Changes

To make changes to this journal entry, click the Edit button. This will open the journal entry form where you can modify any aspect of the transaction.

You can also use the Copy to function to create a new journal entry or recurring journal entry based on this one. This is useful when you need to create similar transactions without starting from scratch.

For more information about creating and editing journal entries, see: Journal Entry — Edit
